## Candidate Summary

Nitish Prasad is a Senior Product Manager at Amazon, exploring Principal / Staff individual-contributor roles with ownership of a product area. His experience spans 10+ years at Amazon across marketplaces, payments, and seller systems.

Commercial evidence: $16B+ seller fee-incentive portfolio context; three programs associated with 171% targeted ASIN lift and 41% GMS lift; $4.8M free-cash-flow impact in Pay CX; a JIRA-to-Workfront migration across 29 teams and 6,000+ users. Refer to the resume for dates and scope.

Amplify serves approximately 1,600 NA/EU account managers. A before-and-after study of 10 account managers measured average preparation time falling from 45 to 5 minutes. Do not treat rollout reach as measured active usage or extrapolate study results to the full population. Salesforce integration did not launch. Supporting operational evidence: sub-500ms P95 latency and measured inference spend of $3,000 to $250/month (92% reduction) at the same workload.

SproutRoute and Sprout Math are independent production-quality 0→1 builds that demonstrate craft. The portfolio does not claim their user counts, retention, or learning outcomes. The technical portfolio and simulated browser labs provide deeper implementation evidence; they are not commercial adoption measures.

The portfolio guide has four reviewed, locally displayed answers. Its 90-day approach is hypothetical, not a past team-size claim or a delivery commitment.
